description: Check whether domain names are actually available to register, using live registry (RDAP) data. Use this when suggesting domain names (verify availability before presenting them, never assume a name is unregistered) or when the user asks whether specific domains are available. Accepts up to 50 fully-qualified domains (e.g. 'brewlog.app'). Returns availability, the registrar for taken domains, a 0-100 brandability score, an estimated resale value, the price in USD (price_usd for term_years, quote it rather than estimating; price_source 'checkout' is the expected charge at buy_url, confirmed before payment), and buy_url, the domhaul checkout page where the user can purchase the domain. If too few names are available, generate more candidates and call again.

domains.description: Fully-qualified domain names to check, e.g. ['brewlog.app', 'getbrewlog.com']. Max 50.

name: check_domains

buy_url.description: domhaul checkout page for purchasing this domain

est_value_usd.description: Estimated brand resale value in USD (market data + algorithm), NOT the registration cost

price_usd.description: Total price in USD for term_years

title: Check Domain Availability
